sections.Profile:
Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck lead their friends through the Acme Factory, collecting film footage to restore it after the Tasmanian Devil tore it apart, in this tribute to the classic Warner Bros. cartoon series that Spooky Pinball revealed in December 2023. Designed by Spooky Luke and Bug Emery, it features a whirling Taz sculpt, a Wile E. Coyote TNT detonator plunger and new voice work by Eric Bauza.

- Manufacturer: Spooky Pinball LLC
- Years made: 2024
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
